EmailTemplate.description: General Case Management Template for Sun Devil Card Services
EmailTemplate.name: Case Mgmt | Sun Devil Card Services Old ID Card Photo
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Unfortunately, the photo we have on file is more than 2 years old. Before we can print a new card, we will require that a new photo be submitted using our Online Photo Upload Portal. Instructions for uploading your photo are below.
Complete step 3 after your photo is approved.
Submit your photo (This is for your ID card) and approved identification to Sun Devil Card Services. https://webapp4.asu.edu/cardservices/
You will need to attach a valid, current photo ID as proof of identity. Acceptable forms of ID are US driver’s license or state issued ID card, US visa, or a passport.
Wait for your photo submission approval email.
Once approved, choose whether you want to pick up your card or have it mailed. Fill out the appropriate form.
A: Mail Request Form https://cfo.asu.edu/campus-id-card-request-form
B: Pickup Request Form https://cfo.asu.edu/webform/basic-sun-card-office-pick-form
Regards, {!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
Sun Devil Card Services Arizona State University Phone: 480-965-2273 cardservices.asu.edu
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
